findings.title: Approval TTL sweep has no production call site; no periodic worker sweep
findings.detail: ApprovalEngine.releaseExpired exists (packages/approval-engine/src/engine.ts:889) and behaves correctly (probe AAA-07), but no non-test file calls it. The governed runtime only sweeps the effect journal at turn start (packages/agent-runtime/src/runtime.ts:425). aaa_execution_contract.md:119 requires releaseExpired at the start of each turn and by periodic worker sweep (AAA03-R3-F03). Recovery of expired approval reservations currently happens lazily via runtime #recoverExpiredReservation on the same approval retry.
findings.impact: No false success or duplicate effect observed; recovery latency/coverage of orphaned reservations is weaker than the contract text.
